text: The 'higher topos theory' programme (Lurie 2009) is relevant to HoTT because:
choices: it provides a model of classical logic
∞-toposes serve as the semantic models for HoTT (they satisfy the Giraud axioms at the ∞-level)
it eliminates the need for proof assistants
it provides models only for cubical type theory
explanation: Lurie's ∞-toposes satisfy ∞-analogues of the Giraud axioms. Voevodsky's conjecture (and Shulman's recent work) shows that ∞-toposes are the intended models for HoTT, connecting type theory to higher categorical semantics.
